title: 第四章 白天第五章 接待员
content_zh:
周游的记性说不上过目不忘，但也绝不是那种转眼就能把一章前的东西忘光的级别。
所以说，他很快地便回想起了那几张报纸的内容。
“事故....频发.....”
“诚招.....急缺......待遇优厚......”
“一摊贩....过劳死....自己的家人........”
就是这个！
周游抬起头，看向那个只剩下半张，但明显沟壑纵横的脸。
——虽然没指名道姓，但这位都操劳成这幅德行了，他不是过劳死还能有谁是过劳死？
眼见得那面容越逼越近，甚至锅内的头颅都开始离开汤汁漂浮起来，周游也顾不上再去想别的，而是轻咳一声，用十分温和的语调说道。
“师傅.....干你们这行的.....一定很辛苦吧。”
......
......
几秒后，那腐烂的人脸在离他不到五六厘米的地方停了下来。
周游也随之长舒一口气。
——看起来他似乎猜对了。
对方没继续攻击，而是缓缓地把头收了回去，然后像是触发了对话的PC一样，开始不住地叹息了起来。
“......哎，干我们这行哪有不辛苦的，早上起床就得准备食材，一直忙活到下午，还没等喘口气呢就得推车出摊，否则连个位置都抢不到，然后从晚上干到凌晨，回家累到沾床就睡，第二天醒来便又是一个循环......原本和我哥一起干的时候还轻松点，但现在只剩下我一个后就有点支撑不住了....”
“额，那请问下，您哥哥呢？”
摊主没回话，而是朝锅里瞟了一眼。
........依稀间，那漂浮的人头和他仅剩的半张脸有些相似。

——亲兄弟吊汤，您也是真能做得出来。
——啊，不，您当我什么都没说好了。
就这么一会断档的时间里，对方的脸似乎又要开始腐烂，周游连忙继续说道。
“那你家里的老婆孩子呢，总能帮衬一点吧？”
谁想到听闻这话，摊主顿时更加的长吁短叹起来。
“哪能指望上他们啊，我老婆每天还得上班去扫大街，赚的也不多，至于我那娃.....他倒是个好孩子，听话懂事，成绩也很好，但他越好我就越不能耽误他啊，所以这所有的事情都得我抗下来...对了，这汤你到底喝不喝了？”
得，看来拖不下去了。
下一刻，回应摊主老板的，只是坚决推回来的一个碗。
“啊，这汤我就不喝了。”周游如是地说道，然后没等对方做出什么反应，他便直接拿起一旁切肉的菜刀。
——见状，那老板和锅里的头都愣了下，接着忽然一齐笑了起来。
“客人，你不会觉得拿旁边这个东西就能杀掉我们把？那你可真是......有够异想天开啊。”
谁想到周游居然也点了点头，表示同意。
“确实，我也觉得这任务不可能就这么轻而易举的完成，但我也真不想喝你那碗破汤，所以说嘛。”周游反转刀尖，笑着对向自己的喉咙。“这东西，是用来了结我自己的。”
刀锋刺下，血光突溅。
-----------------------
“你死了。”
“死于一把陈年生锈的破菜刀之手。”
“你死的毫无价值。”
“你没挖掘出任何侵蚀点，也未对剧情做出任何推动，所以这次死亡无法得到任何奖励。”
“你剩余的复活次数为：14。”

“玩家可以使用10点魂石，将自己死亡前后的十秒进行回放，请问是否回放？”
“请注意，由于玩家已经脱离新手期，不再享受优待，所以此技能在每次剧本中仅能使用一次。”
content_en:
Zhou You's memory can't be called a photographic memory, but it's definitely not the kind that can forget everything a chapter ago in the blink of an eye.
Therefore, he quickly recalled the contents of those newspapers.
"Accidents...happen frequently..."
"Recruiting...urgent need...good pay..."
"A street vendor...died from overwork...his own family..."
That’s it!
Zhou You raised his head and looked at the face with only half of it left, but with obvious grooves.
——Although I didn’t mention him by name, this person has worked hard to achieve this kind of virtue. If he didn’t die from overwork, who else could die from overwork?
Seeing that face getting closer and closer, even the heads in the pot began to float away from the soup, Zhou You couldn't think of anything else, but coughed lightly and spoke in a very gentle tone.
"Master...it must be very hard to do your job..."
...
...
A few seconds later, the rotten human face stopped less than five or six centimeters away from him.
Zhou You also let out a long sigh of relief.
——It looks like he guessed it right.
The opponent did not continue to attack, but slowly put his head back, and then began to sigh as if the PC had triggered the conversation.
"...Hey, there is no hard work in our business. We have to prepare ingredients when we get up in the morning, and we have to work until the afternoon. We have to push the cart out of the stall before we can catch our breath, otherwise we can't even grab a seat. Then we work from night to early morning. When we get home, we are so tired that we fall asleep in bed. When we wake up the next day, it is the same cycle... It was easier when I worked with my brother, but now that I am the only one left, I can't stand it anymore..."
"Well, may I ask, where is your brother?"
The stall owner didn't reply, but glanced into the pot.
.....Vaguely, the floating head was somewhat similar to the remaining half of his face.
——Brother, you can really make soup.
——Ah, no, just pretend I didn’t say anything.
During this short pause, the other person's face seemed to be starting to rot again, so Zhou You quickly continued.
"What about your wife and children at home? Can you help them a little?"
Who would have thought that upon hearing this, the stall owner would sigh even more.
"How can I count on them? My wife has to go to work every day to sweep the streets, and she doesn't earn much. As for my baby... he is a good boy, obedient and sensible, and his grades are very good. But the better he is, the less I can delay him, so I have to resist all these things... By the way, do you want to drink this soup?"
Okay, it seems I can't delay it any longer.
The next moment, the stall owner's response was to push back a bowl firmly.
"Ah, I won't drink this soup." Zhou You said, and then without waiting for the other party to react, he directly picked up the kitchen knife that was used to cut meat.
——Seeing this, the boss and the head in the pot were stunned for a moment, and then suddenly they laughed together.
"Guest, don't you think you can kill us with this thing next to you? Then you are really... very whimsical."
Unexpectedly, Zhou You also nodded and agreed.
"Indeed, I don't think this task can be completed so easily, but I really don't want to drink your bowl of broken soup, so that's what I say." Zhou You turned the tip of the knife and pointed it at his throat with a smile. "This thing is used to kill myself."
The blade stabbed down, and blood splattered.
-----------------------
"You're dead."
"Death at the hands of an old, rusty kitchen knife."
"You died worthless."
"You didn't dig out any erosion points, and you didn't make any progress in the plot, so this death can't be obtained in any way.What reward. "
"The number of resurrections you have left is: 14. "
"Players can use 10 soul stones to replay the ten seconds before and after their death. Do you want to replay it? "
"Please note that since the player has left the novice stage and no longer enjoys the preferential treatment, this skill can only be used once in each scenario. "
